mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals weakening consumer demand and labor market, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high labor market slack (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating job conditions that reduce consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates worsening labor market conditions that reduce household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400 thousand units for two consecutive months, residential sector contraction reduces consumer wealth and confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1400 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals manufacturing contraction and restrictive policy, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0), a decline in manufacturing output signals economic overheating that prompts monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0 and INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03.
